The diagram above shows the angle $\theta =\frac{11\pi }{6}$ in the coordinate plane. Expressed in radians, what is its reference angle ${\theta }_{R}?$

${\theta }_{R}\,=$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14225277/assets/4672b0e5bf7db7d8eecc659ecd988c94d7e290c426a673d82d9b3299f02dc20b.png)

The reference angle, denoted ${\theta }_{R},$  is the angle that $\theta $ makes with the $x$-axis.

As $\theta $ is in the fourth quadrant, its reference angle is given by

$$
{\theta }_{R}=2\pi -\theta .
$$

Therefore,

$$
{\theta }_{R}=2\pi -\frac{11\pi }{6}=\frac{\pi }{6}.
$$
